lane: زَاهٍ [act. part. n. of زَهَا]. === إِبِلٌ زَاهِيَةٌ _Camels that will not pasture upon the_ [_plants,_ or _trees, termed_] حَمْضِ: (ISk, S:) pl. زَوَاهٍ. (TA.) === زَاهِى اللَّوْن _Bright in respect of colour._ (TA.) ثِيَابٌ زَاهِيَةٌ: see زَهْوٌ, last sentence.
